items.html: And afterward, in the throat, where the clothing of Aba and Ima began there, and the female began to separate from the male — therefore the female's drop in the throat had its 42 in two names of Ehyeh that add up to 42, as mentioned. Thus we find that the one name Yud-Hey-Vav of the male, which equals 42 in gematria, is as great as the two drops of the female, which are the two names of Ehyeh, and both together equal one 42.
